geometry_signature: sha256 over config_type followed by sorted UTF-8 rows family<TAB>genus<TAB>binomial for all temporally resolvable species under the frozen semantic rules
canonical_representative: lexicographically smallest family + U+001F + trait_name among systems sharing one geometry signature
simulation_seed: Use the inherited deterministic seed rule with the canonical representative family and trait_name. The resulting known-truth PASS/HOLD is assigned to every system in that exact geometry group.
exactness_scope: All systems in a group have identical semantic class and identical species/genus/family set; with the same pinned backbone/scenario they therefore have identical S3 and prune-only geometry.
